Clark Pacific designs, manufactures, and builds complete parking structures — delivering high-quality, seismically resilient facilities on time and on budget with single-source accountability.
Single source for the complete parking structure, from entitlement to hand-over.
Designated team dedicated to parking design and consulting services.
Your builder for prefabricated parking structures.
The latest in seismic-resistance technology and one of the best performing lateral resistance systems available.

The Precast Hybrid Moment Frame (PHMF) system allows larger column spans — creating more flexible parking layouts, better pedestrian environments, and structures that perform better in seismic events.

Unlike traditional shear-wall systems, PHMF transfers lateral loads through ductile moment connections — reducing the number of walls required and opening up ground-level retail, residential, and mixed-use program opportunities.
Larger column spans for greater design flexibility
Superior ductility in high seismic zones
Fewer shear walls — more flexible ground-floor program
Factory-built connections deliver consistent quality at scale
Point of contact from design through warranty
